body.description: Request body (optional). Can be any JSON structure. Supports expressions in string values.

uri.description: URI of the endpoint. Can contain expressions: "https://api.example.com/${.resource}"

headers.description: HTTP headers (optional). Values can contain expressions: "Bearer ${TOKEN}"

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH).

timeout_seconds.description: Request timeout in seconds. Max: 300 (5 minutes). Optional — unset (0) leaves the request bounded by the runner's activity timeout. NOTE: an explicit value is accepted but not yet applied by the runner; the activity timeout governs either way. Unset (0) is valid: proto3 implicit presence makes an omitted field indistinguishable from 0, so the range rule must not fire on it (#673).
